IB 2027 · SL · Unit 12

Unit 12: Case Study Inquiry

SL curriculum overview and structured learning plan.

Introduction

How do we apply computer science to the unknown?

This unit prepares you for Paper 1 Section B. Each year, the IB releases a 'Case Study' scenario describing a fictional organization facing a new technological challenge (e.g., Rescue Robots, Automated Airports). Your job is to research the emerging technology and propose strategic solutions.

You will start by analyzing the Scenario to identify stakeholders and problems. Then you'll conduct Research into the specific technology (outside the standard syllabus). Finally, you'll practice answering the Challenge Questions, justifying your strategy with evidence.

Scenario Analysis

The Case Study is a 6-page booklet. You must unpack it line-by-line:

  • Stakeholders: Who is affected? (Operators, Customers, Public).
  • Current System: What is broken or outdated?
  • New Tech: What is being proposed? (e.g., vSLAM, Lidar, Blockchain).
Syllabus Integration

You must link the Case Study back to what you know:

  • Theme A: How does the network/hardware support this?
  • Theme B: What algorithms/logic are required?
  • Integration: How does standard theory explain this new tech?
Strategic Evaluation

The final question is an essay. You must:

  • Evaluate: Weigh the pros and cons of a decision.
  • Justify: Explain WHY your solution is best.
  • Synthesize: Combine case facts with your research.
Key Terminology
TermDefinition
Case Study A document detailing a specific scenario involving emerging technology, used for Paper 1 Section B.
Primary Research Information you gather yourself (e.g., testing similar software, interviewing experts).
Secondary Research Information from existing sources (e.g., academic papers, tech news, specifications).
Challenge Question The final question in the exam which asks for a strategic solution to a complex problem.
Justification Providing valid reasons or evidence to support an opinion or conclusion.
Emerging Technology Tech that is currently developing or will be developed in the next 5-10 years (e.g., Quantum, AR, AI Swarms).

Syllabus Coverage

  • Paper 1 Section B: Case Study
  • AO1 Understanding the System
  • AO2 Applying Theory
  • AO3 Evaluating Strategies

Applications
